reason: This is not a narrow cleanup in a peripheral file set. It rewires core plan-cache paths in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go` plus `optimizer.go`, `planbuilder.go`, and `pkg/planner/optimize.go`, with a related change in `pkg/util/hint/hint.go` and integration result updates. Plan cache behavior sits on optimizer/planner semantics and prepared-statement/runtime correctness, so even a 'simplify' PR can hide high-severity regressions in plan reuse, hint handling, partition-table behavior, and correctness of cached vs non-cached plans.
